youtube.title: Philip II threatened the wrong city… Sparta replied with ONE word 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Philip II of Macedon conquered Greece, then threatened Sparta with a whole paragraph. 🛡️

Sparta answered with one word. The most savage reply in history.

Could YOU reply this cold? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on the laconic reply reported by Plutarch: Philip warned that if he invaded Laconia he would raze Sparta, and the Spartans replied simply "If." Neither Philip nor Alexander ever attacked Sparta.

#sparta #spartans #philipiiofmacedon #ancientgreece #ancienthistory #historymemes #funnyhistory #shorts
